about: drawn after Trossen Robotics' store photos of the WidowX AI (2026-11-12): the matte black housing with its two end shells, the ground steel guide rail across its front, the black anodised wrist actuator behind it, the two matte black racks, the grained black finger backbones and the black silicone sock (the Library's part).  link_6 is shared out by boxes: the rail's six triangles, the housing (every triangle from 57 mm up its axis), the actuator (the rest).  The rail's holes and every screw are the project's own drawing, not the model's, as plain cylinders: on the rail the two empty counterbores 50 mm from its middle and the two black socket-head screws 30 mm from it (bodies/trossen-widowx-ai/drawn-rail-bores.stl, drawn-rail-holes.stl, drawn-rail-screws.stl, drawn-rail-sockets.stl), and the black button-head screw with its hex socket on each end shell's outer face (drawn-shell-screws.stl, drawn-shell-sockets.stl).  Not modelled: the rail's ends inside the hollow shells with their screws 70 mm out (the model's shells are solid and its rail stops at them), the fingers' three screws each (the backbone is HandUMI's, with four holes elsewhere), the carriage brackets, their boards, the pinion, cables and camera.

shell-charcoal.evidence: the head-on store photo (ArmFront) and the leader photo on white (GripperwithHand): the end shells and the racks are the lightest blacks of the gripper, a matte charcoal with no sheen, #525253 and #4f5156 where lit and nowhere lighter than #5f5f61, over the finger backbone at #39393b and the actuator at #1c1d1f.  A lighter colour under less of the room's reflections than the base look: at the Assembled home the housing reads #49494b (lit faces #4d4d4f), from the fingertips #343437, and from below #4e4e50 with the racks at #555557; lifted by its reflections alone (#343436 at 1.8) the same faces read #5a5a5b and #68686a from below, a mid grey

rail-ground.evidence: the head-on store photos (ArmFront, ArmNoCameraFront) and the leader photo on white (GripperwithHand): a ground steel guide rail with fine lengthwise lines, clipped white where it mirrors the softbox and still a metal grey, #5c5c5c to #878b92, where it does not.  A flat strip mirrors one patch of the room: mirror-smooth it was #3c3e41 from the fingertips, all but the housing's black, and at roughness 0.4 the card's own white from end to end (#f2f5fa and #f1f4fa on a card of #f5f5f7) turned to the back and a quarter turn to the left; with the ground face's broad scatter it reads #afb2b8 at the Assembled home, #b8bcc1 a quarter turn to the right, #94979c from the fingertips, #e5e9ef turned to the back and #c3c6cc a quarter turn to the left (its narrow side face #eaeef4 there), its highlight still near white but under the card's tone at every side

bore-steel.evidence: the head-on store photo (ArmFront), both halves of the rail: the empty counterbore's turned cone is an even silver grey round its black hole, lighter than the rail where the rail is dark and greyer than it where the rail mirrors the softbox, so it scatters more than the ground face does

actuator-satin.evidence: the side store photo (ArmPerspective5) and the leader photo on white (GripperwithHand): the wrist actuator is the darkest black of the gripper, #1c1d1f to #3d4043, a satin anodised can with one broad soft band of light and no sharp reflection.  With the base look the band where the can mirrors the dark of the room was dead black (darker than #181818 in 11 % of the can a quarter turn to the right, its darkest tenth #13151b) and its end face a mid grey from below (#939396); as a satin skin that scatters more of the room it reads #3e3f43 at the Assembled home, its darkest tenth #26272b there and #1c1e23 a quarter turn to the right, nothing darker than #181818 at the home, the three quarter turns, from the fingertips or from below, the end face #747577 from below.  With the studio at 1.8 the can's lit face at the Exploded home was #4c4d50, as light as the shell beside it (#4e4e51), where the leader photo's can is #2b2d2f under an end shell of #4c4c4e (the verification of 2026-11-13); at 1.3 it is #3b3c3f there, the darkest black of the gripper again, and no more of the drawing darker than #181818 at the home or turned 90, 180 or 270 degrees (at 1.1, 7 % of it turned 180)

sock-silicone.evidence: the side store photo (ArmPerspective5): the smooth moulded silicone sock on the finger tip reads #474748, a lighter satin black than the grained backbone behind it at #2e2f31

screw-black-oxide.evidence: the head-on store photo (ArmFront) and the leader photo on white (GripperwithHand): black-oxide socket-head screws in the rail's counterbores, #19191a, darker than every black round them, with a dull sheen and a darker hex socket; the side store photo (ArmPerspective5) and the leader three-quarter photo (ArmPerspective1): the end shells' button-head screw is the same black, #4f4f4f with glints to #8a8a8a on a shadowed shell and #464646 on a lit one, not a bright steel.  As a mirror-dark metal (metalness 1, #1c1c1e) the rail's heads read #010104 from the fingertips, darker than their own sockets; with a skin that scatters they read #242428 there over sockets at #19191c and #464649 at the Assembled home, the shells' heads #4c4c4f at the home and #78787a from below

hole-dark.evidence: the head-on store photo (ArmFront): the empty counterbores' holes and the screws' hex sockets are the blackest spots of the gripper, darker than the screw heads round them; the base matte black read #222225 from the fingertips, lighter than the heads, this one #19191c there and #2c2c2e at the Assembled home
